rows.text: switches on dword `02B40E14`: 0 stores 1 there and 0 to dword `02B40EC0`; 1 calls `00862130(byte [02B40E20], 02B40E3E)` and stores 0xc to `02B40E14`; 12 tests `ecx` and, when `ecx` is 0 or -4 (`ecx`+4 with bit `0x4` masked off is zero), zeroes the qword at `02B40E14` and the dword at `02B40E10`, otherwise stores 9 to dword `02B40E18` and zeroes the qword at `02B40E10`; any other value returns without writing

returns `0x82000000` when qword `[rcx]` is zero; when its low byte is 2, 8 or 9 it calls `007AB460(rsp+0x20)` and, if that is not negative, writes 0xd to dword `[p]`, qword `[rcx]` to `[p+8]`, `xmm1` to float `[p+0x10]` and `r8d` to dword `[p+0x14]` of the returned record `p` and returns `007AB550(p)`; when the low byte is 7 it calls `007BAD60(rsp+0x20)` and, if that is not negative, writes 0x10, qword `[rcx]` and `xmm1` to `p`, `p+8` and `p+0x10` and returns `007BAE50(p)`; a negative result from either first call is returned as is, and any other low byte returns -1; the stack cookie is checked through `00808C40`

calls `007B24F0` with the incoming registers to get `h`, calls through `008C20B8` with `h` and calls `007B2470` with a stack copy of qword `[rcx]`; when that returns null it calls through `008C20C0` with `h` and returns 0, otherwise it calls `007D0A10` with the returned pointer, calls through `008C20C0` with `h`, and when `dl` is non-zero returns the `eax` of `007D0A10`; when `dl` is zero it repeats the `008C20B8`, `007B2470`, `008C20C0` sequence, calling through `008C21B0` with 1 after each lookup that returns non-null, and returns 0 once a lookup returns null
